entries.source:
A vaguely tentacled yet rapidly changing shape floats here.  With each breath you can feel reality twist, shatter, and break. 
Blue burns into red, green bursts into yellow, and the air crackles and hisses before exploding into a thousand fragments of sharp shapes and colors.
entries.target:
一团隐约带着触手、却在飞速变幻的形体漂浮在这里。每一次呼吸，你都能感到现实在扭曲、碎裂、崩坏。
蓝色烧成红色，绿色爆成黄色，空气噼啪嘶鸣，随后炸裂成千片尖锐的形状与色彩。

entries.source: Dozens - hundreds maybe? - of blood-gorged worms, of varying shapes and sizes, making a writhing, ichor-soaked sea of tooth-lined maws and sickly green skin, ready to latch onto you and drink until they burst or your veins run dry.
entries.target: 几十条——也许几百条？——形状、大小各异的蠕虫吸饱了鲜血，汇成一片浸满脓液、不断翻腾的虫海，满是布满利齿的大口和病态的绿色皮肤。它们随时准备缠住你吸血，直到自己胀破，或你的血管被吸干。

entries.source:
A horror from the deepest pits of the earth. It looks like a huge pile of tentacles all trying to reach for you.
You can discern a huge round mouth covered in razor-sharp teeth.
entries.target:
这是来自地底最深处的恐魔。它看上去像一大堆触手，每一条都想要抓住你。
你能辨认出一张巨大的圆形嘴巴，里面布满了剃刀般锋利的牙齿。

entries.source: Time seems to warp and bend around this floating weapon.
entries.target: 时间似乎在这把漂浮的武器周围扭曲、弯折。

entries.source: A vile looking liquid flows from the teeth of this agile monster. It glides through the water towards you, spined fins jutting outwards.
entries.target: 这个敏捷怪物的齿间流淌着令人作呕的液体。它在水中向你滑游而来，带刺的鳍向外凸出。

entries.source: It looks like a hole in spacetime, but you get the impression it's somehow more than that.
entries.target: 它乍一看像是时空中的一道缝隙，但你隐约觉得它不只是这样。

entries.source: A strange blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团奇怪胶状物体。

entries.source: A strange green blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团绿色胶状物体。

entries.source: A strange red blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团红色胶状物体。

entries.source: A strange blue blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团蓝色胶状物体。

entries.source: A strange white blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团白色胶状物体。

entries.source: A strange yellow blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团黄色胶状物体。

entries.source: A strange black blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团黑色胶状物体。

entries.source: A strange black blob on the dungeon floor; through it you seem to be able to see other times and places. As you stare you see things moving out of it.
entries.target: 地板上的一团黑色胶状物体。通过它你似乎能看到其他时间和地点。当你盯着它时，你发现有东西正从它里面冒出来。

entries.source: Only the most powerful spellcasters raised to unlife become liches. Doomed to haunt the world for an eternity, they have grown to hate all that breathes or trespasses on their domain. Unfortunately that includes you.
entries.target: 只有最强大的施法者被转化为不死之身后，才会成为巫妖。他们注定要永远在世间游荡，渐渐憎恨起一切会呼吸的生灵和擅闯其领地者。不幸的是，这也包括你在内。

entries.source: Having thought to discover life eternal, these beings have allowed undeath to rob them of the joys of life. Now they seek to destroy it as well.
entries.target: 这些存在本以为能求得永生，却让不死之身夺走了生之乐趣。现在，他们也试图毁灭生命。

entries.source: An elder being from a now-forgotten age, filled and fueled by its hate and rage toward all things living, it seeks to deprive all others of a prize it cannot have... life.
entries.target: 一位存活了不知多少岁月的巫妖，它对这个世界和生者充满了仇恨，所以它试图去剥夺生者所拥有而它所没有的财富——生命。

entries.source: Blacker than the deepest night, this cold cruel form of darkness approaches.  Long ago it laid aside its mortality, but it has not forgotten its power; rather, its malice and hate have bent this undead entity on the destruction of all things living.
entries.target: 比最深沉的暗夜还要漆黑，这个冰冷残忍的黑暗形体正在逼近。很久以前它抛弃了自己的凡躯，但并未忘却自身的力量；恰恰相反，它的恶意与仇恨驱使这个不死存在一心毁灭所有活物。

entries.source: The seething, pumping, disembodied blood of a horrendously powerful necromancer. To strike it is to bathe in the rivers of the Fearscape itself.
entries.target: 来自一位极其强大的死灵法师的沸腾、搏动、脱离躯体的血液。攻击它就等于在恶魔空间本身的河流中沐浴。

entries.source: Losgoroth are mighty void elementals, native to the void between the stars. They are rarely seen on a planet's surface.
entries.target: 洛斯格罗斯是强大的虚空元素生物，原生于群星之间的虚空。在星球表面几乎看不到这种生物。

entries.source: Manaworms are losgoroth which feed on the mana of arcane users. If they ever come in contact with a spellcaster, they latch on and start draining mana away.
entries.target: 法力蠕虫是以奥术使用者的法力值为食的洛斯格罗斯。如果它们近距离接触到施法者，就会缠上去吸干对方的法力值。

entries.source: A monstrous demon, covered in acidic thorns.
entries.target: 一只畸形的恶魔，身上长有酸性尖刺。

entries.source: Under a shroud of darkness you discern an evil shape.
entries.target: 在一片黑暗的笼罩下，依稀可见一道邪恶的身影。

entries.source:
This demon would look like a minotaur, if a minotaur had a fiery aura surrounding it and horns all over its body.
Oh, and it is twice as big, too.
entries.target:
这只恶魔长得像一只米诺陶斯，如果米诺陶斯周身环绕着炽焰光环、全身长满尖角的话。
哦，而且它还有两倍大。

entries.source: This terrible demon is covered in blood, which flows *on* its skin in ever-changing patterns that disturb you simply when looking at it.
entries.target: 这只可怕的恶魔浑身是血，鲜血在其皮肤*表面*以不断变化的图案流淌，光是看着就让你浑身不舒服。

entries.source:
You can only guess at the real shape of this demon. Its body is surrounded by a cloud of fiery darkness.
It moves swiftly toward you, casting terrible spells and swinging its weapons at you.
entries.target:
你只能猜测这只恶魔的真实形态。它的身体被一层炽热的黑暗所笼罩。
它迅速向你逼近，一边施放可怕的法术，一边挥舞武器攻击你。

entries.source: One of Urh'Rok's own champions. A thousand nightmares made flesh and screaming steel tower before you in the form of a massive, armored humanoid.
entries.target: 乌鲁洛克麾下的冠军之一。一千个噩梦化作血肉与尖啸的钢铁，以庞大的装甲人形之姿耸立在你面前。

entries.source: A burning giant wielding a forge hammer of the underworld in each hand -- weapons imbued by Urh'Rok himself with the power to crush and shape felsteel. Enter their range at your peril.
entries.target: 一个浑身燃烧的巨人，双手各持一柄来自地底的锻造巨锤——由乌鲁洛克亲自赋予碾碎和锻造魔钢之力的武器。踏入它们的攻击范围，后果自负。
库马纳，乌鲁洛克的将军

entries.source: This massive form, sheathed in dark flames, stands tall above a legion of lesser demons. In his hands he holds a massive blackened battleaxe, flames dancing around the blades.
entries.target: 这个庞大的躯体笼罩在黑暗之炎中，他在一群小恶魔中显得鹤立鸡群。在他手里握着一柄沉重的双手斧，火焰在刀锋处舞动。

entries.source: A small demon, lobbing spells at you.
entries.target: 一只小恶魔，它向你发射法术。

entries.source: Acid oozes all over this small demon's skin.  Beware, they tend to hunt in packs.
entries.target: 酸液从这只小恶魔的身体上渗出。当心，它们喜欢群体行动。

entries.source:
A gaunt vaguely humanoid shape featuring unadorned grey leathery skin. Its arms and legs seem somehow too long and it stands tall, projecting an ominous shadow even in darkness.
Its glowing red eyes shine with both cruelty and a deep frightening intellect.
entries.target:
一个憔悴、隐约近似人类的身影，全身是毫无修饰的灰色革质皮肤。它的胳膊和腿不知为何过于修长。当它耸立在那里的时候，即使在黑暗中也会投下不祥的阴影。
它发光的红色眼睛闪烁着，目光里蕴含着既残酷又深邃可怕的智慧。

entries.source: A small, heavily armoured demon, rushing toward you.
entries.target: 一只装备了重甲的小恶魔，它向你发起冲锋。

entries.source: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
entries.target: 它拥有人类和牛的特征。

entries.source: A belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, and armed with a hammer.
entries.target: 好战的米诺陶，装备有一柄巨锤且拥有强力的魔法。
